product_overview: SahayakAI is an AI-powered citizen welfare intelligence platform that helps eligible Indian citizens reduce welfare application friction through onboarding, scheme matching, risk auditing, and CSC-assisted phygital support. It combines deterministic eligibility checks, explainable risk prediction, multilingual assistance, and token-based kiosk booking to prevent administrative exclusion.
core_goals: Reduce welfare application rejection caused by administrative and documentation friction
Provide deterministic scheme matching and verified eligibility guidance without AI hallucination
Predict and explain application rejection risk using XGBoost and SHAP
Enable phygital CSC kiosk discovery, token booking, and status tracking
Offer multilingual conversational support and voice interaction for low-literacy users
Provide administrators with visibility into high-risk citizens and district-level welfare bottlenecks

features.name: Citizen Onboarding and Socioeconomic Profiling
features.description: Guides a citizen through a 3-step profile wizard to capture demographics, socioeconomic status, document readiness, and digital literacy for downstream scheme matching and risk analysis.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/schemes/match with a completed citizen profile -> Receive 200 with matched schemes, match percentages, and required documents -> POST /api/v1/risk/assess-risk with the same profile -> Receive 200 with rejection risk score, risk band, and explanation data
POST /api/v1/schemes/match with missing required profile fields -> Receive 400 with validation errors identifying incomplete onboarding data
POST /api/v1/risk/assess-risk with malformed or incomplete citizen payload -> Receive 422 with input validation errors and no risk result

features.name: Deterministic Scheme Matching
features.description: Evaluates citizen eligibility against statutory welfare schemes using rule-based checks and returns verified matches, benefits, and document requirements.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/schemes/match with valid citizen demographics and socioeconomic inputs -> Receive 200 with eligible schemes such as PMAY-G, PM-KISAN, PM-JAY, IGNOAPS, and PMUY -> Review exact match percentages and checklist of mandatory documents
POST /api/v1/schemes/match with conflicting eligibility attributes or invalid category data -> Receive 400 with rule validation errors and no scheme recommendations

features.name: Access Risk Meter and SHAP Explainability
features.description: Predicts administrative rejection risk and explains the main barriers contributing to the score, helping citizens understand whether they can apply online or should seek CSC support.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/risk/assess-risk with a complete citizen profile -> Receive 200 with probability score, low/medium/high risk band, and top barrier contributions from SHAP -> Use the result to decide online submission or assisted filing
POST /api/v1/risk/assess-risk with missing features required by the model -> Receive 422 with schema validation errors and no prediction
POST /api/v1/risk/assess-risk with out-of-range or invalid numeric values -> Receive 400 with input constraints violation details

features.name: Dynamic Document Pre-Screening and OCR
features.description: Analyzes uploaded documents using OCR and masking logic to detect document readiness issues before application submission.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/documents/analyze with supported document images or scans -> Receive 200 with extracted text, document type insights, and pre-screening findings -> Review any detected issues such as expired certificate indicators or missing identity fields
POST /api/v1/documents/analyze with unreadable or corrupted files -> Receive 400 with file processing errors and no analysis output
POST /api/v1/documents/analyze with unsupported file format -> Receive 415 indicating unsupported media type

features.name: CSC Kiosk Locator and Priority Booking
features.description: Helps citizens find nearby CSC/Jan Seva Kendra locations, book a priority token, and track the status of an appointment or kiosk visit.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/kiosks/nearby with district or pincode filters -> Receive 200 with a list of nearby CSC kiosks, contact details, and distances -> POST /api/v1/kiosks/book-token with a selected kiosk and citizen details -> Receive 200 with an immutable appointment token and QR pass details -> GET /api/v1/kiosks/track/{reference_id} -> Receive 200 with current token or appointment status
GET /api/v1/kiosks/nearby with missing or invalid location filters -> Receive 400 with filter validation errors
POST /api/v1/kiosks/book-token with incomplete citizen or kiosk data -> Receive 422 with booking validation errors
GET /api/v1/kiosks/track/{reference_id} with an unknown reference ID -> Receive 404 indicating token or appointment not found

features.name: Multilingual Voice-Enabled RAG Scheme Chatbot
features.description: Provides a global conversational assistant for welfare questions, with official scheme knowledge retrieval and optional text-to-speech output in multiple languages.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/chat/schemes-knowledge -> Receive 200 with indexed scheme knowledge and gazette-backed references -> POST /api/v1/chat with a user question in Hindi, English, or Hinglish -> Receive 200 with a grounded answer and cited scheme guidance -> POST /api/v1/chat/tts with the assistant response text -> Receive 200 with synthesized audio output
POST /api/v1/chat with an unsupported language or empty message -> Receive 400 with chat input validation errors
POST /api/v1/chat/tts with empty or overly long text -> Receive 422 with text-to-speech generation validation errors

features.name: API Setu Developer Sandbox Gateway
features.description: Exposes API Setu discovery, sample payloads, and verification workflows for sandbox testing and integration readiness.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/apisetu/status -> Receive 200 with API Setu gateway status -> GET /api/v1/apisetu/samples -> Receive 200 with sample request and response payloads -> POST /api/v1/apisetu/verify with verification data -> Receive 200 confirming API Setu integration readiness
GET /api/v1/apisetu/status when the gateway is unavailable -> Receive 503 with service unavailability details
POST /api/v1/apisetu/verify with invalid credentials or malformed verification payload -> Receive 400 or 401 with verification failure details
